partition.note: The query syntax in Resource Explorer supports `resourcetype:` filters to read one kind and negated `-resourcetype:` filters to leave kinds out, and `resource_count[*].complete` shows whether the result is complete.

sources.note: Resource Explorer search returns resources of all types across the account (and regions with an aggregator index), making it the broadest inventory.
The tagging API lists tagged resources of every service in the region without any prior setup, with the kind derived from the ARN's service and resource-type segments.

acm/certificate.note: ACM certificates are imported by their full ARN.

acm:certificate.note: ACM certificates are imported by their full ARN.

apigateway/.note: The /apis/ path is an HTTP or WebSocket API, which is imported by its API ID.

apigateway:apis.note: API Gateway v2 APIs are imported by their API ID.

apigateway:apis/integrations.note: HTTP/WebSocket API integrations are imported as api-id/integration-id.

apigateway:apis/routes.note: API Gateway v2 routes are imported as api_id/route_id.

apigateway:apis/stages.note: API Gateway v2 stages are imported as api-id/stage-name.

application-autoscaling/scalable-target.note: The import ID is service-namespace/resource-id/scalable-dimension, and the scalable-target ARN's opaque suffix contains none of these parts, so a lookup is required.

apprunner:autoscalingconfiguration.note: App Runner auto scaling configuration versions are imported by their ARN.

athena:datacatalog.note: Athena data catalogs are imported by catalog name.

athena:workgroup.note: Athena workgroups are imported by workgroup name.

autoscaling:autoScalingGroup.note: Auto Scaling groups are imported by group name.

cloudformation/stack.note: CloudFormation stacks are imported by stack name, which is the first segment after stack/.

cloudformation:stack.note: CloudFormation stacks are imported by stack name, which is the first segment after stack/.

cloudwatch/alarm.note: Metric alarms, the most common alarm type, are imported by alarm name, which is everything after :alarm:.

cloudwatch:alarm.note: Metric alarms, the most common alarm type, are imported by alarm name, which is everything after :alarm:.

ec2/instance.note: EC2 instances are imported by instance ID.

ec2/internet-gateway.note: Internet gateways are imported by igw ID.

ec2/launch-template.note: Launch templates are imported by launch template ID.

ec2/network-interface.note: Network interfaces are imported by ENI ID.

ec2/route-table.note: Route tables are imported by route table ID.

ec2/security-group.note: Security groups are imported by group ID.

ec2/subnet.note: Subnets are imported by subnet ID.

ec2/volume.note: EBS volumes are imported by volume ID.

ec2/vpc.note: VPCs are imported by VPC ID.

ec2/vpc-endpoint.note: VPC endpoints are imported by vpce ID.

ec2:dhcp-options.note: DHCP option sets are imported by their dopt- ID.

ec2:elastic-ip.note: Elastic IPs are imported by allocation ID.

ec2:instance.note: EC2 instances are imported by instance ID.

ec2:internet-gateway.note: Internet gateways are imported by igw ID.

ec2:key-pair.note: Key pairs are imported by key name, but the ARN only holds the key-pair ID, so the name has to be looked up separately.

ec2:launch-template.note: Launch templates are imported by their lt- ID, which is the last part of the ARN.

ec2:network-acl.note: Network ACLs are imported by their acl- ID.

ec2:network-interface.note: Network interfaces are imported by their eni- ID.

ec2:route-table.note: Route tables are imported by their rtb- ID.

ec2:security-group.note: Security groups are imported by their sg- ID.

ec2:security-group-rule.note: Individual rules are imported by sgr- ID; ingress is picked as the more common variant (egress rules use aws_vpc_security_group_egress_rule with the same ID).

ec2:subnet.note: Subnets are imported by their subnet- ID.

ec2:volume.note: EBS volumes are imported by their vol- ID.

ec2:vpc.note: VPCs are imported by their vpc- ID.

ec2:vpc-endpoint.note: VPC endpoints are imported by their vpce- ID.

ecr/repository.note: ECR repositories are imported by repository name.

ecr:repository.note: ECR repositories are imported by repository name, which may contain slashes.

ecs/capacity-provider.note: ECS capacity providers are imported by their ARN.

ecs/cluster.note: ECS clusters are imported by cluster name.

ecs/service.note: ECS services are imported as cluster-name/service-name.

ecs/task-definition.note: Task definitions are imported by their full revision ARN.

ecs:capacity-provider.note: ECS capacity providers are imported by their ARN.

ecs:cluster.note: ECS clusters are imported by cluster name.

ecs:container-instance.note: ECS container instances are EC2 hosts registered by the ECS agent, and the provider has no resource type for them.

ecs:service.note: ECS services are imported as cluster-name/service-name.

ecs:task-definition.note: Task definitions are imported by their full revision ARN.

elasticache/cluster.note: ElastiCache clusters are imported by cluster ID.

elasticache/replicationgroup.note: Replication groups are imported by replication group ID.

elasticache/subnetgroup.note: ElastiCache subnet groups are imported by name.

elasticache:cluster.note: ElastiCache cache clusters are imported by cluster ID.

elasticache:replicationgroup.note: ElastiCache replication groups are imported by replication group ID.

elasticache:subnetgroup.note: ElastiCache subnet groups are imported by name.

elasticache:user.note: ElastiCache users are imported by user ID.

elasticfilesystem/file-system.note: EFS file systems are imported by their fs- ID.

elasticfilesystem:file-system.note: EFS file systems are imported by their fs- ID.

elasticloadbalancing/listener-rule.note: Listener rules are imported by their ARN.

elasticloadbalancing/loadbalancer.note: Load balancers are imported by their ARN.

elasticloadbalancing/targetgroup.note: Target groups are imported by their ARN.

elasticloadbalancing:listener-rule/app.note: Listener rules are imported by their ARN.

elasticloadbalancing:listener/app.note: Load balancer listeners are imported by their full ARN.

elasticloadbalancing:loadbalancer/app.note: Load balancers are imported by their full ARN.

elasticloadbalancing:targetgroup.note: Target groups are imported by their ARN.

events/rule.note: Rules are imported as 'bus/rule', or just the rule name on the default bus, matching the ARN's path.

events:event-bus.note: EventBridge event buses are imported by bus name.

events:rule.note: Rules are imported as 'bus/rule', or just the rule name on the default bus, matching the ARN's path.

guardduty:detector.note: GuardDuty detectors are imported by detector ID.

kms/key.note: KMS keys are imported by key ID.

kms:key.note: KMS keys are imported by key ID.

lambda/event-source-mapping.note: Event source mappings are imported by their UUID.

lambda/function.note: Lambda functions are imported by function name.

lambda:event-source-mapping.note: Lambda event source mappings are imported by their UUID.

lambda:function.note: Lambda functions are imported by function name.

lambda:function/version.note: Published function versions have no resource type of their own; aws_lambda_function creates them when publish is true.

logs/log-group.note: Log groups are imported by name.

logs:log-group.note: Log groups are imported by name.

memorydb:acl.note: MemoryDB ACLs are imported by name.

memorydb:parametergroup.note: MemoryDB parameter groups are imported by name.

memorydb:user.note: MemoryDB users are imported by user name.

rds/db.note: RDS instances are imported by DB instance identifier.

rds/pg.note: DB parameter groups are imported by name.

rds/subgrp.note: DB subnet groups are imported by name.

rds:auto-backup.note: The only type that manages automated backups is the cross-region replication resource, which is imported by the automated backup ARN.

rds:db.note: RDS instances are imported by DB instance identifier.

rds:og.note: RDS option groups are imported by option group name.

rds:pg.note: RDS DB parameter groups are imported by parameter group name.

rds:snapshot.note: DB snapshots are imported by snapshot identifier, which can itself contain a colon (rds:...).

rds:subgrp.note: RDS DB subnet groups are imported by subnet group name.

resource-explorer-2:index.note: Resource Explorer indexes are imported by their full ARN.

resource-explorer-2:view.note: Resource Explorer views are imported by ARN.

s3/.note: S3 buckets are imported by bucket name.

s3:bucket.note: S3 buckets are imported by bucket name.

ses:identity.note: aws_sesv2_email_identity manages both email and domain SES identities and is imported by the identity name taken from the end of the ARN.

sqs/.note: SQS queues are imported by queue URL, which is built from the region, account and queue name.

sqs:queue.note: aws_sqs_queue is imported by queue URL, which is built from the region, account and queue name in the ARN.

ssm/parameter.note: aws_ssm_parameter is imported by parameter name, which keeps its leading slash for hierarchical names and has none for flat names.

ssm:managed-instance.note: No Terraform type manages an SSM managed-instance registration itself, since aws_ssm_activation only creates the activation code and aws_instance manages the underlying EC2 instance.

ssm:parameter.note: aws_ssm_parameter is imported by parameter name, which keeps its leading slash for hierarchical names and has none for flat names.

xray:group.note: aws_xray_group is imported by its group ARN, which is the inventory ID.

xray:sampling-rule.note: aws_xray_sampling_rule is imported by the rule name, which is the last part of the ARN.
